name: PINE BARREL SAUNA WITH PANORAMIC VIEW
description:
Pine Barrel Sauna with Panoramic View a gorgeous. This beautifully designed indoor and outdoor sauna’s is a stylish addition to any home. The toughened brown, tempered glass door contributes to a quiet, relaxing environment, and remains undamaged by temperature changes. This sauna is uniquely designed with a glass dome wall, giving you an open view of your surroundings. 

Transform the Pine Barrel Sauna with Panoramic View into a wet sauna by pouring water over the hot stones, boosting temperature and humidity for maximum health benefits and relaxation. Assembly is simple and can be accomplished in just a few hours with the help of our instruction manual. Included with Sauna Purchase.   Sauna Benefits: Sleep better, stimulate blood circulation, increase metabolism, prevent heart disease, relax tired muscles/joints, heal colds and flu.  Other Sauna Benefits: Eliminate fatigue, clean and nourish skin, reduce fat and keep fit, relieve muscle and joint pain, flush toxins from the body.

*Shingle Roof Not Included.*
